info.title: TradingAPI supplement
info.description: Supplementary TradingAPI operations maintained in this repository until they are available in the upstream source.

OrderPageBidSize.description: One price band in the tick-size table and its minimum price increment. When a price is greater than `str_proceed` and not greater than `end_proceed`, use this band's `bid_size`.

bid_size.description: Minimum price increment in this band, for example "0.01"

OrderPageOrderTypeConfig.description: Trading sessions and time-in-force values supported by one order type

support_sessions.description:
Trading sessions supported by this order type:
- `1` - Regular trading hours only
- `2` - Regular trading hours plus pre-market and after-hours
- `3` - Overnight session only
- `4` - Pre-market (used for overnight options trading)

An empty list means the order type has no session option, and the order page should hide session selection.

support_time_in_forces.description:
Time-in-force values supported by this order type:
- `0` - Day (DAY)
- `1` - Good till canceled (GTC)
- `3` - Immediate or cancel (IOC)
- `5` - Fill or kill (FOK)
- `6` - Good till date (GTD)

OrderPageGrantedStatus.description: Authorization status of one trading qualification, certification, or risk statement

status.description:
Certification status:
- `0` - Unknown
- `1` - Passed
- `2` - Not passed
- `3` - Pending review

expired.description: Whether the authorization or certification has expired. If it has, the user must complete it again.

url.description: URL of the page where the user completes this authorization or certification

OrderPageChannelInfo.description: Trading configuration of the current account for this security. In addition to the fields below, the response contains several `*_granted` booleans (whether the corresponding authorization, certification, or risk statement is complete) with matching certification URL fields (`*_url`, `*_granted_url`). Some apply only to specific markets or businesses, and the server determines which fields are present. When a value is `false`, guide the user to the matching URL before submitting the order, and call this endpoint again afterward to refresh the status.

account_channel.description: Account channel. Together with `org_id` and `aaid`, it identifies the account this configuration belongs to.

currency.description: Quote currency of the security, for example USD, HKD, or GBX

settlement_currency.description: Available settlement currencies. The first item is the default trading currency; pass it as `currency` when you query positions and cash, buying power, and estimated fees.

order_type_config.description: Order type configuration available for this security and account. Keys are order type codes, for example `LO` (limit order), `ELO` (enhanced limit order), `MO` (market order), `LIT` (limit-if-touched), and `MIT` (market-if-touched). An order type that does not appear is unavailable. When this object is returned, use the per-order-type configuration for sessions and time in force.

support_trade.description: Whether the current account channel supports trading. When `false`, do not offer order entry.

restricted.description:
Online trading restriction:
- `1` - Online buying is not allowed
- `2` - Online selling is not allowed
- `3` - Neither online buying nor online selling is allowed

If the field is absent or has another value, no such restriction applies. For a restricted direction, direct the user to contact the Broker offline.

support_rth.description: Whether pre-market and after-hours trading is supported. When `order_type_config` is returned, `support_sessions` in it takes precedence.

support_overnight.description: Whether overnight trading is supported. When `order_type_config` is returned, `support_sessions` in it takes precedence.

gtd_support_order_types.description: Order type codes that support good-till-date (GTD) orders

support_attached_order_types.description: Order type codes that accept attached orders

support_fractional_shares.description: Whether US fractional-share trading is supported

fractional_min_amount.description: Minimum amount, in USD, for a fractional-share order placed by amount. Orders below this amount are rejected.

mo_avail_ratio.description: Buying-power factor for market orders. Available buying power for a market order (including an untriggered market conditional order) equals `buy_limit` from Get Buying Power for Order Entry multiplied by this factor. Treat an empty value as 1.

finance_account_status.description:
Margin credit status:
- `0` - Normal
- `1` - Credit limit is 0 and an adjustment request is under review
- `2` - Credit limit is 0 and no request is under review

When the value is `1` or `2`, trades that require margin credit, such as opening a short stock position or selling to open options, cannot proceed. Tell the user to wait for review or request a limit adjustment.

account_risk_level.description:
Account risk level:
- `0` - No additional statement is required
- `1` - The user must confirm the trade-anyway statement before ordering
- `2` - The user must confirm the important notice before ordering

confirm_purchase_statement.description: Whether the user has confirmed the trade-anyway statement

confirm_important_notice.description: Whether the user has confirmed the important notice

granted_info.description: Authorization status of each trading qualification and risk statement. Keys are qualification type codes, for example `us_overnight_risk_agreement` (US overnight trading risk statement) and `fractional_shares_risk_agreement` (fractional-share trading risk statement). The server determines the other keys.

OrderPageStockContract.description: Option contract information, returned only for options

contract_direction.description: Option type: `C` for a call, `P` for a put

underlying_counter_id.description: Security ID of the underlying stock

nearing_expire.description: Whether the option is close to expiry

contract_model.description:
Option margin mode:
- `1` - Non-margin mode
- `2` - Margin mode

open_purchase_limit.description: Minimum buying power required to open an option position. No threshold applies when `threshold` is empty or 0.

OrderPageTradableButton.description: Guidance button in the tradability dialog

type.description:
Action on tap:
- `0` - Close the dialog without entering order entry
- `1` - Open the order page for this security
- `2` - Open the page that `link` points to

direction.description:
Order direction when `type` is `1`:
- `0` - Not restricted
- `1` - Buy only
- `2` - Sell only

TradeAuthToken.description: Trade token and its refresh token, issued per account

token.description: Trade token. Pass it as `tradeToken` to `WhaleCoreService.updateTradeToken(...)`

refresh_token.description: Refresh token. Pass it as `tradeRefreshToken` to `updateTradeToken`; it is also the input of `POST /v1/member/trade/refresh_token`

refresh_token_expires.description: Lifetime of the refresh token, in seconds, counted from issuance

SearchSecurityItem.description: A single security candidate in search results

counter_id.description: Security ID in the format `<product>/<market>/<code>`, such as `ST/US/AAPL`. Use it to identify the security in follow-up actions such as opening the security detail page or adding it to a watchlist

code.description: Security code, such as `AAPL` or `700`. Pass it as the `code` parameter when you load the next page

name.description: Security name in the request language

market.description: Market of the security, such as `HK` or `US`. Broker App uses it to display the market badge

currency.description: Trading currency, such as `USD` or `HKD`. For fund results, Broker App displays the currency instead of the market badge

product.description: Security product code, such as `ST`, `ETF`, or `UT`

score.description: Ranking score of the result. To load the next page, pass the value from the last result of the previous page as the `score` parameter

tx_type.description: Record type code, such as `cash_in` or `cash_out`. Use `type_name` for Client-facing display

type_name.description: Localized record type name in the request language. Broker App displays it as the record title

category.description: Direction prefix for the amount. Broker App prepends it to `amount` as is; when it is empty, only the amount is displayed

amount.description: Cash change amount as a decimal string. An empty value or `0` means the record only involves a change in share quantity

currency.description: Currency of the amount, such as `HKD` or `USD`

stock_quantity.description: Change in share quantity. When it is not empty, `quantity_description` provides the Client-facing text

quantity_description.description: Localized description of the share quantity change. Broker App shows it as the main value when the record only changes shares, and as secondary text when an amount is also present

description.description: Localized supplementary text for the record. Broker App shows it after the date when it is not empty

created_at.description: Record creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Broker App groups the list by the year and month of this time

done_at.description: Record completion time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Broker App displays this date in the list

WithdrawRecordState.description:
Withdrawal request status:
- `0` - Submitted and being processed
- `1` - Processing
- `2` - Rejected
- `3` - Cancelled by the Client
- `4` - Remitted
- `5` - Failed
- `6` - Refunded
- `7` - Approved but not yet remitted
- `8` - Under large-amount withdrawal review
- `9` - Modification pending approval
- `10` - Deletion pending approval
- `11` - Deleted
- `12` - Rejection pending approval
- `15` - To be confirmed: the Client must confirm a change of the receiving bank card before processing continues

Only requests in status `0` or `15` can be cancelled. When displaying the status, prefer the returned `state_description`.

WithdrawPayeeAddress.description: Payee address of a bank card

payee_country.description: Payee country or region as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (for example, `HKG`), taken from `code2` of “Get Payee Countries and Regions”

payee_building.description: Building name; required only for some countries or regions

id.description: Bank card id, used as `card_id` for the pre-check and the withdrawal request

bank_card_identity.description: Bank card identity. Together with `id`, it identifies one bank card; pass it with `card_id` when submitting a withdrawal request

bank_code.description: Bank code; `FPS` indicates a Faster Payment System (FPS) receiving account

account_type.description: Currency the card supports for withdrawals, for example `HKD`; `ALL` means all currencies. The withdrawal currency must match this value unless it is `ALL`

region.description: Full name of the region where the bank card is issued, for example `HONGKONG`

status.description:
Bank card verification status:
- `0` - Not verified; the card must be verified first
- `1` - Under verification review; withdrawals cannot be submitted
- `2` - Verified

witness_state.description:
Deposit witness status:
- `1` - No witness required
- `2` - Witness pending
- `3` - Witnessed

For accounts opened with cash verification, only cards in status `1` or `3` can be used for withdrawals.

bind_state.description:
Binding status:
- `0` - Binding under review
- `1` - Bound
- `2` - Binding failed

Treat a missing value as bound. Only bound cards can be used for withdrawals.

PortfolioExchangeRate.description: Rate of one currency against the base currency

other_currency.description: Currency, such as `USD`. The item whose `other_currency` equals `base_currency` has a rate of `1`

bid_rate.description: Bid rate: amount of `base_currency` per 1 unit of `other_currency`, used to convert positive amounts

offer_rate.description: Offer rate: amount of `base_currency` per 1 unit of `other_currency`, used to convert negative amounts

OptionStrategyExpireDate.description: Expiration date available for option strategy screening

to_days.description: Number of days remaining until expiration

OptionStrategyScreenerLeg.description: One leg of the strategy (stock or option contract)

counter_id.description: Security ID (counter_id) of the leg, for example `ST/US/AAPL` for a stock or `OP/US/AAPL261120C230000` for an option

order.description:
Order direction of the leg:

- `0` - Buy
- `1` - Sell

direction.description:
Option type:

- `C` - Call
- `P` - Put

Not applicable to a stock leg

strike_price.description: Strike price. Not applicable to a stock leg

expire_date.description: Expiration date in `YYYYMMDD` format. Not applicable to a stock leg

strategy.description:
Strategy type:

- `1` - Long Call
- `2` - Long Put
- `3` - Short Call
- `4` - Short Put
- `5` - Covered Call
- `6` - Covered Put
- `7` - Protective Call
- `8` - Protective Put
- `9` - Long Straddle
- `10` - Long Strangle
- `15` - Bull Call spread
- `16` - Bull Put spread
- `17` - Bear Call spread
- `18` - Bear Put spread
- `19` - Short Straddle
- `20` - Short Strangle

stock.description: Contract of a single-leg strategy. Empty for a multi-leg strategy; use `pair_stocks` instead.

pair_stocks.description: Legs of a multi-leg strategy. May include both stock and option legs.

action.description:
Premium direction when opening the position:

- `debit` - Net premium paid
- `credit` - Net premium received

probability.description: Probability of profit as a decimal, for example `0.396` for 39.6%

max_profit.description: Maximum profit. An empty value means the profit is theoretically unlimited.

max_loss.description: Maximum loss. An empty value means the loss is theoretically unlimited.

alert_type.description:
Risk reminder type:

- `0` - No reminder
- `1` - Covered Call reminder: selling the stock position during the period leaves the call option naked, which may raise the margin requirement
- `2` - Covered Put reminder: closing the short position during the period leaves the put option naked, which may raise the margin requirement

CorpActionSubscribeType.description:
Subscription corporate action type:
- `RIGHTSISSUE` - Rights issue
- `TAKEOVER` - Tender offer

CorpActionSubscribeState.description:
Subscription status:
- `UNSELECT` - Pending
- `PROCESSING` - Processing
- `UNDISTRIBUT` - Pending distribution
- `DISTRIBUTED` - Distributed
- `REVOKED` - Cancelled

CorpActionSubscribeSearch.description: Paging and filter conditions for subscription corporate actions

state.description: Filter by subscription status. See `CorpActionSubscribeState` for values. Pass `ALL` to skip this filter.

type.description: Filter by event type. See `CorpActionSubscribeType` for values. Pass `ALL` to skip this filter.

size.description: Records per page. The Broker App uses 10.

CorpActionSubscribeEvent.description: A rights issue or tender offer event available for subscription

ann_id.description: Corporate action event ID. Convert it to a number when calculating fees or subscribing.

order_id.description: Subscription order ID. An empty value or `"0"` means the Client has not subscribed yet.

currency.description: Currency of the subscription price and fees

price.description: Subscription price: the rights issue price for rights issues, or the offer price for tender offers

max_subscribe_quantity.description: Maximum quantity that can be subscribed, in shares

is_excess.description: Whether this is an excess rights application. Applies only to rights issues.

record_date.description: Record date, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

start_time.description: Subscription start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

end_time.description: Subscription closing time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

distribute_date.description: Estimated distribution date, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

CorpActionSubscribeOrder.description: A rights issue or tender offer subscription order

ann_id.description: Corporate action event ID. Convert it to a number when calculating fees or subscribing.

currency.description: Currency of the subscription price and fees

distribute_quantity.description: Distributed quantity, in shares. Populated when `state` is `DISTRIBUTED`.

fee_amount.description: Total fee. See `currency` for the currency.

is_excess.description: Whether this is an excess rights application. Applies only to rights issues.

record_date.description: Record date, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

start_time.description: Subscription start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

end_time.description: Subscription closing time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

distribute_date.description: Estimated distribution date, as a Unix timestamp in seconds, in string form

CorpActionVotingSearch.description: Paging and filter conditions for shareholder meetings

market.description: Market code. The Broker App uses `HK`.

ann_id.description: Shareholder meeting ID. When provided, only this meeting is queried.

size.description: Records per page. The Broker App uses 10.

CorpActionVotingAttendType.description:
Attendance method:
- `0` - Unspecified
- `1` - Proxy voting
- `2` - In-person attendance
- `3` - Proxy attendance

Only `1`, `2`, and `3` are valid when submitting an instruction.

CorpActionVotingCertificateType.description:
Attendee identification document type:
- `0` - ID card
- `1` - Passport
- `2` - Driver's license
- `3` - Business license
- `4` - Business registration
- `5` - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)
- `6` - Other business document
- `10` - PR ID card
- `11` - Citizen ID
- `12` - Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macao

CorpActionVotingApplyStatus.description:
Shareholder meeting instruction status:
- `1` - To apply
- `2` - Pending
- `3` - Completed
- `4` - Cancelled
- `5` - Processing

Only instructions in status `2` can be cancelled.

CorpActionVotingAttendee.description: Attendance method and attendee information. When `attend_type` is `2` (in-person attendance) or `3` (proxy attendance), also provide the attendee name, gender, document type, document number, and address. When it is `1` (proxy voting), only `attend_type` is needed.

attendee_name.description: Attendee name in English. Only English letters, digits, and common punctuation are allowed.

attendee_identification_number.description: Attendee document number. Only English letters, digits, and common punctuation are allowed.

attendee_address.description: Attendee address in English. Only English letters, digits, and common punctuation are allowed.

CorpActionVotingMeeting.description: A shareholder meeting that accepts instructions

meeting_type.description: Display text for the meeting type, such as Annual General Meeting

meeting_time.description: Meeting time in `YYYYMMDD HH:mm` format, interpreted in UTC+8

polling_number.description: Number of votes available, in shares

amount.description: Service fee for submitting the instruction. See `currency` for the currency.

voting_start_date.description: Application start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

voting_deadline.description: Application deadline, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. If no instruction is submitted before the deadline, the Client is considered to have waived the meeting.

proxy_details.description: Proposal list. For proxy voting, submit one vote for each proposal.

proxy_serial.description: Proposal number. Pass it as `chosen_proxy_serial` when voting.

CorpActionVotingRecord.description: A submitted shareholder meeting instruction record

meeting_type.description: Display text for the meeting type, such as Annual General Meeting

meeting_time.description: Meeting time in `YYYYMMDD HH:mm` format, interpreted in UTC+8

polling_number.description: Number of votes available, in shares

amount.description: Service fee for submitting the instruction. See `currency` for the currency.

voting_start_date.description: Application start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

voting_deadline.description: Application deadline, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. If no instruction is submitted before the deadline, the Client is considered to have waived the meeting.

proxy_time.description: Instruction submission time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

voting_details.description: Voting details for each proposal. A non-empty array means the attendance method is proxy voting.

statement_id.description: Annual statement ID used by “Get annual statement download URL”. `0` means the statement for that year has not been generated yet and cannot be downloaded

year.description: Statement year as a four-digit string, such as `2025`

generated_at.description: Generation time text returned by the server in the request language. It may describe when the statement was generated or when it is expected to be generated. Display it as is; do not parse it

key.description: Language code. Submit it as `lang` when setting the statement language

val.description: Display name of the language. Show it as is

selected.description: Whether this is the currently selected statement language

event_id.description: Option ID used when submitting the election

amount.description: Estimated cash amount if all registered shares elect this option, as a decimal string

surplus_value.description: Dividend per share, as a decimal string. Submit it as `cash_surplus_value` when calculating a stock-and-cash split

is_default.description: Whether this is the default cash option. If none is marked, use the first option

event_id.description: Option ID used when submitting the election

counter_id.description: Security ID of the shares to be distributed, such as `ST/HK/700`

counter_code.description: Ticker of the shares to be distributed

counter_name.description: Name of the shares to be distributed

currency.description: Currency of the conversion price and per-share value

exchange_price.description: Conversion price, as a decimal string

surplus_value.description: Dividend per share for the scrip option, as a decimal string. Submit it as `stock_surplus_value` when calculating a stock-and-cash split

stock_payable.description: Estimated shares receivable if all registered shares elect the scrip option. It is also the upper limit of shares that can be allocated in a stock-and-cash split

ann_id.description: Event ID used for calculation and submission

counter_id.description: Security ID of the holding, such as `ST/HK/700`

origin_quantity.description: Registered shares, that is, the shares eligible for this corporate action

record_date.description: Record date as a Unix timestamp in seconds

election_from.description: Election start time as a Unix timestamp in seconds

in_side_election_to.description: Election deadline as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The Client must submit before this time

payable_at.description: Expected payment date as a Unix timestamp in seconds

choose_rights.description:
Elected option, present only for events already elected:

- `CashDividend` - All cash
- `ScripDividend` - All shares
- `ScripAndCash` - Shares and cash

distribute_state.description:
Distribution status, used in history:

- `SELECTED` - Elected, pending distribution
- `DISTRIBUTED` - Distributed

cash_event.description: Cash options. When there is more than one, the Client can choose by currency

DepositRecordState.description:
Deposit request status:
- `0` - Processing
- `1` - Credited
- `2` - Failed
- `3` - Cancelled
- `4` - Voided
- `5` - Rejected
- `11` - Returned

`0` is the only non-terminal status; all other values are terminal.

id.description: Notice id. Use it to remember which notices the Client has closed

link.description: Page to open when the Client selects the notice. When empty, the notice is not selectable

button.description: Button label for the notice. When empty, the Broker App uses its default label

notice_type.description:
Notice type:
- `2` - Withdrawal notice

The withdrawal page shows only notices whose `notice_type` is `2`.

account_channel.description: Broker channel the notice applies to. Show only notices that match the current channel

region_ids.description: Applicable bank card regions, separated by commas, such as `HONGKONG,SINGAPORE`. `all` means every region. Match it exactly against `region` of the selected receiving bank card

region_bank_ids.description: Applicable bank ids, separated by commas. `-1` means every bank. Match it exactly against the bank id of the selected receiving bank card

region_id.description: Legacy region field. Use it when `region_ids` is absent; it follows the same rules

region_bank_id.description: Legacy bank id field. Use it when `region_bank_ids` is absent

client_display_way.description:
Display mode:
- `1` - Closable; shown again after refresh
- `2` - Closable; never shown again after the Client closes it
- `3` - Not closable; always shown

priority.description: Priority. Higher values are shown first

show_begin.description: Display start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

show_end.description: Display end time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Do not show the notice when the current time is outside `show_begin` to `show_end`

RewardLockActivity.description: Reward-lock campaign affected by a withdrawal

disclaimer_url.description: URL of the campaign rules page. When empty, do not show a rules entry

reward_type.description:
Reward type:
- `0` - Cash
- `1` - Physical item
- `2` - Card or coupon

goods_name.description: Reward name. Use it to show the reward when `reward_type` is not `0`

amount.description: Amount in cents (for example, `10000` means 100.00). When `reward_type` is `0`, it is the cash reward amount; when `violate_type` is `2`, it is also the campaign fee deducted from the account balance

violate_type.description:
Consequence of withdrawing:
- `1` - The Client loses campaign eligibility and forfeits further rewards
- `2` - A campaign fee is deducted from the account balance

status.description:
Reward issuance status:
- `1` - Pending
- `2` - Partially issued
- `3` - Issued

withdraw_cash_ex_mmf.description: Withdrawable cash excluding money market funds

frozen_buy_cash.description: Amount held by pending buy orders

opening_balance_today.description: Opening cash balance, which is the balance at the end of the previous trading day

AssetOverviewCashBalance.description: Cash breakdown for one currency. Total cash in the currency = `balance` + `frozen_buy_cash` + `external_amount`

AssetOverviewProductBalance.description: Holdings and in-transit amounts of one product class (funds, bonds, or other assets) in one currency

quantity.description: Holding quantity. It may be returned as a number; parse it as a numeric value

available_quantity.description: Sellable quantity. It may be returned as a number; parse it as a numeric value

market_price.description: Price used to calculate market value

today_pl.description: Profit and loss from today's executions, excluding unrealized profit and loss on holdings

achieves_pl.description: Holding profit and loss based on average purchase cost

achieves_pl_percent.description: Holding profit and loss ratio based on average purchase cost

achieves_diluted_pl.description: Holding profit and loss based on diluted cost

achieves_diluted_pl_percent.description: Holding profit and loss ratio based on diluted cost

pretrade_today_pl.description: Profit and loss from today's executions when US pre-market and post-market prices are included. Use it only when that asset setting is on and the security is in the pre-market or clearing session

trade_status.description: Security trading status code as a string. Values follow `TradeStatus`

quantity.description: Holding quantity. It may be returned as a number; parse it as a numeric value

available_quantity.description: Sellable quantity. It may be returned as a number; parse it as a numeric value

today_pl.description: Profit and loss from today's executions, excluding unrealized profit and loss on holdings

achieves_pl.description: Holding profit and loss based on average purchase cost

achieves_pl_percent.description: Holding profit and loss ratio based on average purchase cost

achieves_diluted_pl.description: Holding profit and loss based on diluted cost

achieves_diluted_pl_percent.description: Holding profit and loss ratio based on diluted cost

trade_status.description: Security trading status code as a string. Values follow `TradeStatus`

total_balance.description: Holding amount. One currency may be split into multiple records; sum them when you show the balance of that currency

AssetOverviewMmfHolding.description: Money market fund holding used for idle cash

recent_trading_day.description: Trading day of the latest return for this product class

list.description: Holdings. It is an empty array when there are no holdings

AssetFundBondGroup.description: Holding summary of one product class

isin.description: ISIN code. Returned for funds only

freeze_units.description: Frozen units. It has a value only while a sale is being processed

recent_trading_day.description: Trading day of the latest return

close_price.description: Latest closing price. Returned for bonds only

price_time.description: Time of `close_price`. Returned for bonds only

AssetFundBondHolding.description: A single fund, bond, or other asset holding

multi_name.description: Localized currency names as a JSON string keyed by language code, such as `zh-CN` or `en`. Parse it and read the value for the current language

abbreviation_multi_name.description: Localized short currency names as a JSON string in the same format as `multi_name`

amount_precision.description: Number of decimal places for amounts

min_withdrawal_amount.description: Minimum withdrawal amount. `0` means the amount must be greater than 0

support_exchange.description: Whether currency exchange is supported: `yes` or `no`

app_show.description: Whether to show the currency in the profit and loss analysis currency selector: `yes` or `no`

supports.description: Availability of the currency in each funding scenario

json_config.description: Extended configuration as a JSON string. Account opening reads `support_deposit` (`yes` or `no`) from it to filter depositable currencies

market_price.description: Market value of the asset class in the currency

last_pl.description: Latest profit and loss of the asset class in the currency. It may be an empty string

AssetWealthCategoryItem.description: Summary of one wealth asset class in one currency

counter_id.description: Product ID (`counter_id`). Use it to query position details

quantity.description: Position quantity

coupon_2_rate.description: Second-stage conditional coupon rate. Empty means the product has no second-stage coupon

market.description: Market code of the underlying security

ki_price.description: Knock-in price. Do not show it when the product has no knock-in feature

AssetStructuredUnderlying.description: Price metrics of an underlying security of a structured product

profit_max.description: Profit and loss of the most profitable security in the period

profit_max_name.description: Name of the most profitable security in the period

loss_max.description: Profit and loss of the security with the largest loss in the period

loss_max_name.description: Name of the security with the largest loss in the period

AssetPLSummaryInfo.description: Top profit and largest loss of one asset class

quantity.description: Order quantity

Hong Kong and Singapore stocks:

OrderWidgetCheckItem.description: A pre-order check item that the Client must confirm

type.description:
Check item type:

- `1` - Reminder; the Client can continue after confirming it (for example queued orders, margin calls, PDT, or day-trading buying power)
- `2` - Assessment; open `click_url` to complete an assessment or risk confirmation (for example OTC, warrants and CBBCs, or virtual asset ETFs)

body.description: Body text; may contain `{{key}}` template variables that you replace with the values of the same keys in `param`

click_url.description: Destination URL for an assessment item

check_url.description: Rich-text content of a declaration item; may contain agreement links

checkbox.description: Confirmation phrase next to the checkbox of a declaration item; may contain template variables. If empty, use a default confirmation phrase

OrderReplaceAttachedParams.description: Parameters for modifying attached take-profit and stop-loss orders

attached_order_type.description:
Attached order type:

- `0` - No attached order; if the original order has attached orders, also pass `cancel_all_attached=true` to cancel them all
- `1` - Take-profit order
- `2` - Stop-loss order
- `3` - Bracket order (both take-profit and stop-loss)

profit_taker_id.description: ID of the existing take-profit order; pass it when modifying that order

profit_taker_submit_price.description: Order price after the take-profit order is activated; pass it when the activated order type is a limit type

stop_loss_id.description: ID of the existing stop-loss order; pass it when modifying that order

stop_loss_submit_price.description: Order price after the stop-loss order is activated; pass it when the activated order type is a limit type

activate_order_type.description: Order type after the attached order is activated

activate_rth.description:
Trading session after the attached order is activated:

- `1` - Pre-market and after-hours not allowed
- `2` - Pre-market and after-hours allowed

time_in_force.description:
Time in force:

- `0` - Day
- `1` - Good till canceled (GTC)
- `3` - Immediate or cancel (IOC)
- `5` - Fill or kill (FOK)
- `6` - Good till date (GTD); an expiry time is also required

cancel_all_attached.description: Whether to cancel all attached orders of the main order

main_id.description: Main order ID; required when you modify only the attached orders

quantity.description: Total quantity of the main order; pass it when you modify only the attached orders

market_price.description: Current market price, including pre-market and after-hours; pass it when you modify only the attached orders

OrderQueryStatus.description:
Order status:

- `NotReported` - Not reported
- `ReplacedNotReported` - Not reported after a successful modification
- `ProtectedNotReported` - Not reported (protected order)
- `VarietiesNotReported` - Conditional order being monitored and not yet triggered
- `NotActivate` - Not reported (conditional order not activated)
- `WaitToActivate` - Not reported (conditional order waiting for activation)
- `Activated` - Not reported (conditional order activated)
- `SuspenedStatus` - Suspended
- `WaitToNew` - Submitted, waiting to be reported
- `PendingNewStatus` - Pending new
- `NewStatus` - New
- `WaitToReplace` - Modification waiting to be reported
- `PendingReplaceStatus` - Pending modification
- `ReplacedStatus` - Modified
- `WaitToCancel` - Cancellation waiting to be reported
- `PendingCancelStatus` - Pending cancellation
- `PartialFilledStatus` - Partially filled
- `FilledStatus` - Filled (final)
- `RejectedStatus` - Rejected (final)
- `CanceledStatus` - Canceled (final)
- `ExpiredStatus` - Expired (final)
- `PartialWithdrawal` - Canceled after a partial fill (final)

`SuspenedStatus` is the existing spelling used by the service.

quantity.description: Order quantity

trigger_at.description: Trigger time of a conditional order as a Unix timestamp in seconds; returned only after the order is triggered

monitor_price.description: Monitoring price of a trailing order

limit_offset.description: Limit offset of a trailing stop limit order

done_at.description: Completion time as a Unix timestamp in seconds

security_type.description: Security type; returned for single-option orders

contract_direction.description: Option direction (`C` for call, `P` for put); returned for single-option orders

strike_price.description: Strike price; returned for single-option orders

price.description: Order price

quantity.description: Order quantity

trigger_price.description: Trigger price of a conditional order

msg.description: Additional order message, such as a rejection reason

OrderGridTradingRule.description: Grid trading rule. Use the spread fields (`*_spread_*`) or the percentage fields (`*_percent_*`) according to `trigger_price_type`.

upper_limit_price.description: Upper bound of the price range

upper_limit_event.description:
Handling when the price leaves the range:

- `1` - Do not place orders
- `2` - Close the position at the latest price

lower_limit_price.description: Lower bound of the price range

lower_limit_event.description:
Handling when the price leaves the range:

- `1` - Do not place orders
- `2` - Close the position at the latest price

trigger_price_type.description:
Trigger condition type:

- `1` - By spread
- `2` - By percentage

trigger_spread_up.description: Rise spread that triggers a sell

trigger_spread_down.description: Fall spread that triggers a buy

trigger_percent_up.description: Rise percentage that triggers a sell

trigger_percent_down.description: Fall percentage that triggers a buy

pullback_spread.description: Pullback spread; pass it when pullback tracking is on

rebound_spread.description: Rebound spread; pass it when rebound tracking is on

pullback_percent.description: Pullback percentage; pass it when pullback tracking is on

rebound_percent.description: Rebound percentage; pass it when rebound tracking is on

grid_order_type_up.description:
Sell side. How the order is placed after the grid triggers:

- `GMO` - Market order at the market price
- `GLO` - Limit order; priced at the market price when `trigger_*_depth` is `0`, otherwise at the specified order book level
- `GTG` - Limit order at the trigger price

grid_order_type_down.description:
Buy side. How the order is placed after the grid triggers:

- `GMO` - Market order at the market price
- `GLO` - Limit order; priced at the market price when `trigger_*_depth` is `0`, otherwise at the specified order book level
- `GTG` - Limit order at the trigger price

trigger_sell_depth.description: Sell order. Order book level: `-1` to `-5` are bid levels 1 to 5, and `1` to `5` are ask levels 1 to 5. Pass `0` when the order uses the market price or the trigger price

trigger_buy_depth.description: Buy order. Order book level: `-1` to `-5` are bid levels 1 to 5, and `1` to `5` are ask levels 1 to 5. Pass `0` when the order uses the market price or the trigger price

time_in_force.description:
Time in force:

- `0` - Day
- `1` - Good till canceled (GTC)
- `3` - Immediate or cancel (IOC)
- `5` - Fill or kill (FOK)
- `6` - Good till date (GTD); an expiry time is also required

expire_time.description: Expiry time as a Unix timestamp in seconds; required when `time_in_force=6`

rth.description: Grid trading session, using the same values as `force_only_rth` when placing orders; pass it when the security supports pre-market and after-hours trading

support_shortsell.description: Whether the grid order allows short selling

upper_limit_quantity.description: Maximum position quantity; pass it when the position range is on

lower_limit_quantity.description: Minimum position quantity; pass it when the position range is on

AccountTransferStatus.description:
Transfer status:
- `0` - Submitted
- `1` - Pending review
- `2` - Approved
- `3` - Rejected
- `4` - Succeeded
- `5` - Failed
- `6` - Cancelled

`3`, `4`, `5`, and `6` are terminal. `0`, `1`, and `2` mean the transfer is still being processed.

transfer_no.description: Transfer number, used to query a single record

from_origin_no.description: Account number of the source account, for display

to_origin_no.description: Account number of the destination account, for display

from_account_type_name.description: Type name of the source account. May be empty

to_account_type_name.description: Type name of the destination account. May be empty

transfer_amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string

apply_time.description: Submission time as a Unix timestamp in seconds

account_time.description: Completion time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Present only when `status` is `4` (succeeded)

AccountTransferStockItem.description: A stock in a stock transfer batch

counter_id.description: Security ID in the format `<type>/<market>/<code>`, such as `ST/HK/700`

name_locals.description: Stock name in the current language. Show `code` when empty

AccountTransferStockTicket.description: A stock transfer batch. Each stock in the batch has its own status.

batch_no.description: Batch number, which is the `ref_no` used at submission

apply_time.description: Submission time as a Unix timestamp in seconds

from_origin_no.description: Account number of the source account, for display

to_origin_no.description: Account number of the destination account, for display

from_account_type.description:
Source account level:
- `0` - Main account
- Other values - Sub-account

to_account_type.description:
Destination account level:
- `0` - Main account
- Other values - Sub-account

TradeOrderMultiLegQuery.description: Multi-leg query: the main security, the strategy type, and the security of each leg

counter_id.description: Main security ID of the combination: the counter_id of the underlying stock, such as `ST/US/AAPL`

multiLeg.description: Strategy and legs of the combination

strategy.description:
Multi-leg strategy type:
- `0` - Covered call
- `1` - Covered put
- `2` - Vertical call spread
- `3` - Vertical put spread
- `4` - Collar
- `5` - Straddle
- `6` - Strangle
- `7` - Calendar call spread
- `8` - Calendar put spread

counter_id.description: Security ID of the leg: the option contract counter_id for an option leg, or the stock counter_id for a stock leg

TradeOrderMultiLegInfo.description: Display information of the multi-leg combination and the ratio of each leg

code.description: Combination code, used as the order title

ratio_quantity.description: Ratio quantity of the leg per combination unit. Pass it as `legs[].ratio_quantity` when you submit the multi-leg order

TradeOrderAttachedParams.description: Attached order (take-profit / stop-loss) parameters. An attached order belongs to the main order submitted in this request and is activated only after the main order is filled. Only order types listed in `channel_infos.support_attached_order_types` returned by Get Order Configuration support attached orders

attached_order_type.description:
Attached order type:
- `1` - Take-profit order
- `2` - Stop-loss order
- `3` - Bracket order (both take-profit and stop-loss)

profit_taker_price.description: Take-profit trigger price. Required when `attached_order_type` is `1` or `3`

stop_loss_price.description: Stop-loss trigger price. Required when `attached_order_type` is `2` or `3`

activate_order_type.description: Order type after the attached order is activated, such as `LIT` (limit if touched) or `MIT` (market if touched)

profit_taker_submit_price.description: Limit price of the take-profit order after activation. Pass it when `activate_order_type` is `LIT`

stop_loss_submit_price.description: Limit price of the stop-loss order after activation. Pass it when `activate_order_type` is `LIT`

activate_rth.description:
Trading session after activation:
- `1` - Regular trading hours only
- `2` - Regular trading hours plus pre-market and after-hours

time_in_force.description:
Time in force of the attached order:
- `0` - Day (DAY)
- `1` - Good till canceled (GTC)
- `3` - Immediate or cancel (IOC)
- `5` - Fill or kill (FOK)
- `6` - Good till date (GTD); `expire_time` is also required

expire_time.description: Expiry time of the attached order as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Required when `time_in_force` is `6`

TradeOrderSubmitRequest.description: Order submission parameters, shared by stock, ETF, warrant, option, and multi-leg orders

order_type.description:
Order type code. It must be a key of `channel_infos.order_type_config` in Get Order Configuration, for example:
- `LO` - Limit order
- `MO` - Market order
- `ELO` - Enhanced limit order
- `ALO` - At-auction limit order
- `AO` - At-auction order
- `ODD` - Odd-lot order
- `SLO` - Special limit order
- `LIT` - Limit if touched
- `MIT` - Market if touched
- `TSLPAMT` / `TSLPPCT` - Trailing stop limit (by amount / by percentage)
- `TSMAMT` / `TSMPCT` - Trailing stop market (by amount / by percentage)
- `MOC` - Market on close

price.description: Limit price in the trading currency. Omit it for market-type orders and trailing stop orders

quantity.description: Order quantity: shares for stocks, contracts for options, or combinations for multi-leg orders. It must match the lot size returned by Get Order Configuration

submitted_amount.description: Order amount when ordering by amount, used for US fractional shares. It must not be lower than `channel_infos.fractional_min_amount` returned by Get Order Configuration

settlement_currency.description: Settlement currency, such as USD or HKD. Use an item of `channel_infos.settlement_currency` returned by Get Order Configuration

time_in_force.description:
Time in force. The value must be in `support_time_in_forces` of the order type in Get Order Configuration:
- `0` - Day (DAY)
- `1` - Good till canceled (GTC)
- `3` - Immediate or cancel (IOC)
- `5` - Fill or kill (FOK)
- `6` - Good till date (GTD); `expire_time` is also required

If omitted, the order is treated as a day order.

expire_time.description: Order expiry time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Required when `time_in_force` is `6`

force_only_rth.description:
Trading session. Use an item of `support_sessions` of the order type in Get Order Configuration:
- `1` - Regular trading hours only
- `2` - Regular trading hours plus pre-market and after-hours
- `3` - Overnight session only
- `4` - Pre-market (option overnight scenario)

Omit it when the security does not support session selection.

trigger_price.description: Trigger price. Required for conditional orders such as `SLO`, `LIT`, and `MIT`

market_price.description: Latest market price when the conditional order is submitted. Compare it with `trigger_price` to determine `trend`

trend.description:
Trigger direction of a conditional order:
- `1` - Triggered when the price rises to the trigger price (the trigger price is above `market_price`)
- `2` - Triggered when the price falls to the trigger price

trigger_count.description: Trigger count of the conditional order

tailing_amount.description: Trailing amount of a trailing stop order (pass it when trailing by amount)

tailing_percent.description: Trailing percentage of a trailing stop order (pass it when trailing by percentage)

limit_offset.description: Limit offset of a trailing stop limit order: after triggering, the order is placed at the market price plus or minus this offset. Omit it when `limit_depth_level` is passed

limit_depth_level.description: Order book level (such as best bid or best ask) used to price a trailing stop limit order. When it is `0` or omitted, `limit_offset` is used

monitor_price.description: Monitoring price of a trailing stop order

card_ids.description: IDs of the cards used by this order, at most one per category (commission-free card, cash card, platform fee deduction card). Cash cards cannot be used for sell orders. If the array is empty or omitted, no card is redeemed for this order

commission_free.description: Whether a commission-free card may be used to offset commission

amount_deducted.description: Whether a stock cash card may be used for deduction

platform_amount_deducted.description: Whether a platform fee deduction card may be used

client_request_id.description: Client request identifier: the millisecond timestamp at submission

id.description: ID of the new order, which you can use to query the order details

notice.description: Trading reminder text. When it is not empty, the Broker App should show it to the Client after the order is submitted

TradeOrderGridRule.description: Grid trading rule. An upward trigger sells and a downward trigger buys

upper_limit_price.description: Upper bound of the price range

lower_limit_price.description: Lower bound of the price range

upper_limit_event.description:
Action when the price breaks above the range:
- `1` - Do not place orders
- `2` - Close the position at the latest price

lower_limit_event.description: Action when the price breaks below the range. Values are the same as `upper_limit_event`

trigger_price_type.description:
Trigger condition type:
- `1` - By price spread; use `trigger_spread_*`, `pullback_spread`, and `rebound_spread`
- `2` - By percentage; use `trigger_percent_*`, `pullback_percent`, and `rebound_percent`

trigger_spread_up.description: By spread: price rise that triggers a sell

trigger_spread_down.description: By spread: price fall that triggers a buy

trigger_percent_up.description: By percentage: price rise that triggers a sell

trigger_percent_down.description: By percentage: price fall that triggers a buy

pullback_spread.description: Pullback tracking spread (pass it when pullback tracking is on)

rebound_spread.description: Rebound tracking spread (pass it when rebound tracking is on)

pullback_percent.description: Pullback tracking percentage (pass it when pullback tracking is on)

rebound_percent.description: Rebound tracking percentage (pass it when rebound tracking is on)

grid_order_type_up.description:
Order method for the sell triggered by a rise. Omit it and pass `trigger_sell_depth` when ordering at an order book level:
- `GMO` - Market price (market order)
- `GLO` - Market price (limit order)
- `GTG` - Trigger price (limit order)

grid_order_type_down.description: Order method for the buy triggered by a fall. Values are the same as `grid_order_type_up`. Omit it and pass `trigger_buy_depth` when ordering at an order book level

trigger_sell_depth.description: Order book level used for the sell order: `1` to `5` for ask 1 to ask 5, and `-1` to `-5` for bid 1 to bid 5. Pass `0` when `grid_order_type_up` is used

trigger_buy_depth.description: Order book level used for the buy order. Values follow `trigger_sell_depth`. Pass `0` when `grid_order_type_down` is used

trigger_sell_quantity.description: Sell quantity for each upward trigger

trigger_buy_quantity.description: Buy quantity for each downward trigger

support_shortsell.description: Whether the grid order may short sell

upper_limit_quantity.description: Maximum position quantity (pass it when the position range is on)

lower_limit_quantity.description: Minimum base position quantity (pass it when the position range is on)

time_in_force.description: Time in force of the grid strategy, using the same values as order time in force. When it is `6`, `expire_time` is also required

expire_time.description: Expiry time of the grid strategy as a Unix timestamp in seconds

rth.description:
Grid trading session (pass it when the security supports pre-market and after-hours trading):
- `1` - Regular trading hours only
- `2` - Regular trading hours plus pre-market and after-hours

CryptoWalletFeeDetail.description: One line of a crypto withdrawal fee breakdown.

fee_name.description: Name of the fee item, such as the exchange fee or the withdrawal service fee. You can show it to the Client as is.

fee_amount.description: Amount of the fee item as a decimal string. Fee items with an amount of 0 or less do not need to be shown.

CryptoWalletDepositStatus.description:
Status of a crypto deposit record:
- `pending_auth` - Verifying (a new address is waiting for the verification deposit; can be cancelled)
- `processing` - In process
- `success` - Completed
- `failed` - Failed
- `canceling` - Canceling
- `cancelled` - Canceled
- `cancel_failed` - Failed to cancel
- `refunding` - Refunding
- `refunded` - Refunded
- `refund_failed` - Failed to refund

CryptoWalletWithdrawStatus.description:
Status of a crypto withdrawal record:
- `processing` - In process
- `success` - Completed
- `failed` - Failed

CryptoWalletRecordQuery.description: Paging and filter conditions for crypto deposit or withdrawal records.

page_no.description: Page number starting from `1`, passed as a string.

page_size.description: Number of records per page, passed as a string. If fewer records than this value are returned, there are no more pages.

id.description: Record id. When provided, only that record is returned; use it to show the record details.

begin.description: Start of the time filter as a Unix timestamp in seconds, usually 00:00:00 of the selected start date. Pass `0` or omit it to skip time filtering.

end.description: End of the time filter as a Unix timestamp in seconds, usually 23:59:59 of the selected end date. Pass `0` or omit it to skip time filtering.

coins.description: Filter by token, such as `["BTC","ETH"]`. An empty array means no filter.

statuses.description: Filter by status, using the values of the record `status`. An empty array means no filter.

currency.description: Settlement currency from `currency` in the search result; requests without it are rejected

cost.description: Cost price, optional; omit the field when not provided

broker_id.description: Delivering broker id from `id` of `GET /v1/portfolio/rollover/brokers`; `0` means another broker not in the list, entered manually by the Client

broker.description: Delivering broker name; same as `broker_en` when `broker_id` is `0`

state_code.description:
Request status code:

- `0` - Submitted
- `1` - Cancelled
- `3` - Deposited
- `5` - In progress
- `7` - Partially deposited
- `8` - Failed

Other values may appear; in that case rely on the `state` text.

Whether the request can be modified or cancelled:

- `1` - Yes; the modify and cancel endpoints can be called
- `0` - No

attachments.description: Object storage keys of the supporting documents. Currently returned as a JSON-serialized string (such as `["<FILE_KEY_1>","<FILE_KEY_2>"]`) that must be parsed first; a plain array is also possible

created_at.description: Submission time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

updated_at.description: Status update time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds; may be returned as a number or a string

process_at.description: Processing start time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds; may be returned as a number or a string

exec_at.description: Execution time, as a Unix timestamp in seconds; may be returned as a number or a string

reason.description: Reason for cancellation, failure, or rejection

counter_id.description: Security ID, such as `ST/HK/700`; may be missing, in which case identify the security by `market` and `code`

state.description:
Per-stock transfer status (returned by the details endpoint):

- `0` - Processing
- `1` - Succeeded
- `2` - Failed

counter_id.description: Security ID, for example `ST/HK/2636`. Tapping an item opens the security details page with this ID

state.description:
IPO stage:

- `1` - Open for subscription
- `2` - Funds frozen (awaiting allotment results)
- `3` - Grey market
- `4` - Listing

result_date.description: Allotment result announcement date in `YYYY.MM.DD` format. Shown when `state` is `2`

sub_state.description:
Subscription result of the current client:

- `0` - Not subscribed
- `1` - Not allotted
- `2` - Allotted

subscription_deadline.description: Subscription deadline in `MM.DD HH:mm` format. Shown when `state` is `1`

subscription_remaining_time.description: Seconds remaining until the subscription deadline

mart_state.description:
Grey market status, used when `state` is `3`:

- `0` - Not started
- `1` - Trading
- `2` - Closed

mart_start_at.description: Grey market start time in `HH:mm` format

mart_end_at.description: Grey market end time in `HH:mm` format

Reservation status:

- `0` - Reserved
- `1` - Successfully reserved; a subscription order has been created
- `2` - Pending cancellation
- `3` - Reservation cancelled
- `4` - Reservation expired
- `5` - Reservation failed: insufficient principal
- `6` - Reservation failed: a subscription order already exists

IpoReservationType.description:
Reservation type:

- `0` - Public offer reservation (bank financing multiple available)
- `1` - International placing reservation

Milestone status:

- `COMPLETED` - Completed
- `ACTIVE` - In progress
- `PENDING` - Not started

get.description:
Retrieves the order rules and configuration for a security under the current account when the user opens the order page, switches securities, or switches accounts: lot size, tick-size table, order price limits, order tag, the trading sessions and time-in-force values supported by each order type, support for good-till-date and attached orders, US fractional shares, available settlement currencies, online buy and sell restrictions, the market order buying-power factor, and the status of authorizations and statements required before ordering. A Broker-built order page uses this response to determine the available order types, sessions, time in force, quantity step, and price step, and to block submission when an authorization is missing. When amending an order, pass the original order ID to get the configuration for that order. After the user completes an authorization or certification, call this endpoint again to refresh the status. This endpoint is also used by the recurring investment plan creation page (to read the trading configuration of the security) and by the options income and protection strategy pages (to read the authorization status of the strategy risk agreement).

WhaleCore's `orderService()` wraps this endpoint as the typed method `getOrderInfo`. If you use WhaleCore, prefer that method.

parameters.name: counter_id
parameters.description: Security ID (counter_id), for example `ST/US/AAPL` or `ST/HK/700`

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: Original order ID when amending an order. Omit it for a new order.

parameters.description: String form of the original order ID. When amending an order, pass the same value as `order_id`.

post.description:
Verifies the trade password entered by the Client. If verification succeeds and no second-factor verification is required, returns the trade token for the account.

WhaleCore handles trade authentication automatically by default, so the host app does not need this operation. When WhaleCore is initialized with `tradePasswordEnabled: true`, the SDK no longer obtains trade tokens itself. When a trading call throws `tradeAuthFailed` (1006) or `hasTradeToken()` returns `false`, the host app asks the Client for the trade password, calls this operation, passes `data.token.token` as `tradeToken` and `data.token.refresh_token` as `tradeRefreshToken` to `WhaleCoreService.updateTradeToken(...)`, and then retries the original operation. Tokens are issued per account, so the `accountChannel` passed to `updateTradeToken` must match the account of this request.

If `need_two_factors` or `need_totp_two_factors` is `true`, do not use any token in this response. Call the matching second-factor operation instead, which returns the token: `POST /v1/member/trade/auth_two_factors` for an SMS verification code, or `POST /v1/member/trade/totp/auth_two_factors` for a third-party authenticator code. Device-token verification, indicated by `need_device_totp_two_factors`, is outside the scope of this document.

This operation is also used to verify the Client’s current trade password before security settings are changed.

If the password is wrong, show `message` and let the Client enter it again. If 402009 is returned, stop retrying.

Password fields carry the MD5 digest of the 6-digit trade password as a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal string. Never send the plaintext password.

This operation obtains the trade token, so do not set `requiresTradeToken` to `true` when you call it through WhaleCore `requestService()`.

trade_password.description: MD5 digest of the trade password

type.description: Verification scenario. Pass `trade` to unlock trading.

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Verify Trade Password” operation.

need_totp_two_factors.description: Whether third-party authenticator (TOTP) second-factor verification is still required. If `true`, call `POST /v1/member/trade/totp/auth_two_factors`

need_device_totp_two_factors.description: Whether device-token second-factor verification is still required. This verification method is outside the scope of this document

tfa_guide.description: If `true`, the SMS second-factor page can offer an option to require the verification code for this unlock only. Submit the choice through `tfa_switch` of `POST /v1/member/trade/auth_two_factors`

token.description: Trade token. Use it only when none of the three `need_*` fields is `true`

x-business-codes.description: The trade password retry limit has been reached and trade unlock for the account is frozen. Show `message` and do not retry

post.summary: Submit SMS Verification for Trade Unlock
post.description:
Completes SMS second-factor verification for trade unlock. After Verify Trade Password returns `need_two_factors: true`, send a trade-unlock SMS verification code to the Client (the send-code operation is outside the scope of this document), and then submit the code with the same trade password. On success, returns the trade token: `data.token.token` maps to `tradeToken` and `data.token.refresh_token` maps to `tradeRefreshToken` of `updateTradeToken`.

If `tfa_switch` is provided, this call also changes whether later trade unlocks for the Client require an SMS verification code. If verification fails, show `message` and let the Client re-enter the code or request a new one.

Password fields carry the MD5 digest of the 6-digit trade password as a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal string. Never send the plaintext password.

This operation obtains the trade token, so do not set `requiresTradeToken` to `true` when you call it through WhaleCore `requestService()`.

trade_password.description: MD5 digest of the trade password, identical to the value submitted to Verify Trade Password

tfa_switch.description:
Changes the SMS verification requirement for later trade unlocks. Omit it to keep the current setting. Offer this choice only when Verify Trade Password returns `tfa_guide: true`:

- `close` - Require SMS verification for this unlock only; later trade unlocks no longer require an SMS code
- `open` - Later trade unlocks continue to require an SMS code

Completes second-factor verification for trade unlock with a code generated by the third-party authenticator (TOTP) app bound by the Client. Call it for the same account after Verify Trade Password returns `need_totp_two_factors: true`. The request does not carry the trade password. On success, returns the trade token: `data.token.token` maps to `tradeToken` and `data.token.refresh_token` maps to `tradeRefreshToken` of `updateTradeToken`.

If the code is wrong or expired, show `message` and let the Client enter a new code.

This operation obtains the trade token, so do not set `requiresTradeToken` to `true` when you call it through WhaleCore `requestService()`.

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Submit Authenticator Code for Trade Unlock” operation.

get.description:
Checks whether the trade token carried by the request is still accepted by the server and returns its remaining lifetime. `hasTradeToken()` only reflects whether a token is held locally, so you can call this operation before opening a trading page to confirm that the server still accepts the token and avoid interrupting the Client after the order form is filled in.

Handle an invalid token by business code: 402000 means the token has expired and can be renewed with the refresh token; 402001 means the token has been invalidated, for example because the account signed in on another device, and the trade password must be verified again.

When you call this operation through WhaleCore `requestService()`, set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

If the host app refreshes tokens itself, pass the returned `data.token.token` and `data.token.refresh_token` to `updateTradeToken` again so that the tokens held by the SDK match the server. A 402003 response means the refresh token has expired and the trade password must be verified again.

When you call this operation through WhaleCore `requestService()`, you do not need to set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

Queries the cash flow records of the current account with pagination. Each record includes the record type, amount and currency, direction prefix, share quantity change text, supplementary text, and creation and completion times. Localized text such as the record type name follows the request's `Accept-Language`.

Without `start` and `end`, results are paged by `page` and `size`; fewer than `size` records means there are no more pages. With `start` and `end`, the operation returns all records in that range and ignores `page`. Some Brokers' customized cash flow record pages also use this operation.

When you call it through WhaleCore `requestService()`, declare the trade token requirement by setting `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

get.description:
Queries the bank cards the Client has bound, together with the bank card and currency used for the last withdrawal. Used on the withdrawal page to select the receiving bank card and to set the default card and currency.

This is the first step of the withdrawal flow. After selecting a card, call “Get withdrawal pre-check information” (`GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/pre`; some tenant channels use `GET /v4/portfolio/withdraw/pre`) for the withdrawable amount and fees, then call `POST /v5/portfolio/withdraw` to submit the withdrawal. Only cards whose `bind_state` is `1` (or absent), whose `status` is not `1`, and whose `account_type` matches the withdrawal currency can be used. When changing the receiving card of a withdrawal request, also pick the new card from this list.

With `withdraw=0`, it returns all bound bank cards; the endpoint is also used by the bank card management page and for selecting bank cards in ACH and wire deposits and withdrawals.

A complete withdrawal flow runs in this order: get the withdrawal bank cards (`GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/cards`) → get the withdrawal pre-check information and withdrawable amount (`GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/pre`; some tenant channels use `GET /v4/portfolio/withdraw/pre`; to get only the withdrawable balance by currency, call `GET /v1/rms_gateway/get_account_all_single_currency_withdraw`) → check and add the payee address when required → submit the withdrawal request (`POST /v5/portfolio/withdraw`) → query withdrawal records and details → cancel the withdrawal or change the receiving bank card when needed.

Usage scenario:
- `1` - Select a card on the withdrawal page
- `0` - Return all bound bank cards (bank card management, ACH and wire deposits and withdrawals)

After the withdrawal currency and receiving bank card are selected, queries the withdrawable limits and withdrawal configuration. It returns the maximum withdrawable amount, the cash amount, the money market fund (MMF) amount, the per-currency breakdown, estimated arrival times, fee tiers by amount range, the available payout methods, and whether withdrawing this currency to this card requires a payee address. Used for the amount display, validation, and fee notices on the withdrawal form. Without `card_id`, it can be used to get card-independent information such as the available payout methods.

General tenant channels use this endpoint; some tenant channels (including southbound and northbound withdrawal scenarios) use `GET /v4/portfolio/withdraw/pre` instead, and the two return largely the same structure. Call it after “Get Withdrawal Bank Cards”. When `need_payee_address` is `true`, call `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/addresscheck` first, then call `POST /v5/portfolio/withdraw` to submit the withdrawal.

When calling through WhaleCore `requestService()`, set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

post.description:
Submits a withdrawal request with the selected currency, amount, and receiving bank card, and returns the withdrawal request id once accepted. `ok` set to `true` means only that the request was accepted; whether the funds are remitted is determined by the withdrawal record status.

Preconditions: a usable card has been selected through `GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/cards`, and “Get withdrawal pre-check information” (`GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/pre` or `GET /v4/portfolio/withdraw/pre`) has confirmed that the amount does not exceed `max_amount` and is not below the currency’s minimum withdrawal amount. If the card requires a payee address, save it first with `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/address`.

Side effects: creates a withdrawal request. On success, use the returned `id` to call `GET /v7/portfolio/withdraw/detail`, and find the request in `GET /v6/portfolio/withdraw/record`. While the status is `0` or `15`, it can be cancelled with `POST /v2/portfolio/withdraw/cancel`. On failure, handle the business code; for other codes, show `message` to the Client instead of resubmitting immediately.

When calling through WhaleCore `requestService()`, set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

A complete withdrawal flow runs in this order: get the withdrawal bank cards (`GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/cards`) → get the withdrawal pre-check information and withdrawable amount (`GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/pre`; some tenant channels use `GET /v4/portfolio/withdraw/pre`; to get only the withdrawable balance by currency, call `GET /v1/rms_gateway/get_account_all_single_currency_withdraw`) → check and add the payee address when required → submit the withdrawal request (`POST /v5/portfolio/withdraw`) → query withdrawal records and details → cancel the withdrawal or change the receiving bank card when needed.

amount.description: Withdrawal amount as a decimal string; must be greater than 0 and not exceed `max_amount` from the pre-check

is_pad_funded.description:
MMF advance mode, with the same meaning as `is_pad_funded` in the pre-check:
- `1` - No redemption; the platform advances the funds
- `2` - Redeem the MMF before withdrawing

The Broker App currently always passes `2`.

bank_operation_type_id.description: Payout method id from `bank_operation_type[].id` in the pre-check; pass `null` or omit it when no payout method is offered

confirm.description: Reward forfeiture confirmation. When this withdrawal disqualifies the Client from a reward-lock campaign or incurs a fee, show the affected rewards (`GET /rewards/lock_activities`) to the Client, obtain consent, and resubmit with `1`; omit it otherwise

get.description:
Queries the withdrawal request records of the current account with pagination, with filters for status, currency, and creation time range. Used to display the withdrawal record list. Get the selectable statuses from `GET /v1/portfolio/withdraw/historyinfo`; when the Client selects a record, call `GET /v7/portfolio/withdraw/detail` with `list[].id`.

Pagination: `page` starts at `1`; when `list` contains fewer items than `size`, there is no more data. Some tenant channels use `GET /v6/portfolio/withdraw/record/no/trade/auth`, a version that returns the same data without trading password verification and takes the same parameters.

When calling through WhaleCore `requestService()`, set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

get.description:
Queries one withdrawal by withdrawal request id, including the amount, fee, status, order number, creation and update times, payee and receiving bank information, payee address, remarks, the history of receiving card changes, whether the receiving card can be changed, and any card change awaiting confirmation. Used on the withdrawal result and details pages.

Next steps: when `state` is `0` or `15`, cancel with `POST /v2/portfolio/withdraw/cancel` using `order_id`. When `can_edit_card` is `true`, change the receiving card with `PUT /v1/portfolio/withdraw/member/change/card`. When `to_be_changed_card` is returned, call `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/change/process` after the Client confirms, to accept the card change. Some tenant channels use `GET /v7/portfolio/withdraw/detail/no/trade/auth`, a version that returns the same data without trading password verification and takes the same parameter, but does not return `card_id`, `payee_address`, or `to_be_changed_card.card_id`.

When calling through WhaleCore `requestService()`, set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

post.description:
Cancels a withdrawal request that has not finished processing. Used for the “Cancel” action on the withdrawal details page. Only requests whose `state` is `0` (submitted) or `15` (to be confirmed) can be cancelled. After cancellation the status becomes `3` (cancelled) and cannot be restored, so the Broker App should ask the Client to confirm before calling.

Get `order_id` from `GET /v7/portfolio/withdraw/detail`. On success, query the details again to refresh the status. On failure, show `message` to the Client and query the details again to confirm the current status.

When calling through WhaleCore `requestService()`, set `requiresTradeToken` to `true`.

order_id.description: Withdrawal order number from `order_id` of the withdrawal details

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Cancel Withdrawal Request” operation.

put.description:
Lets the Client replace the receiving bank card of a withdrawal request in progress. Used for the “Update Bank Info” action on the withdrawal details page. On success, the receiving bank information in the details is updated and a new entry is added to `records`.

Preconditions: `can_edit_card` in the withdrawal details is `true` and `state` is `0` or `15`. Pick the new card from `GET /v3/portfolio/withdraw/cards`; it must be verified (`status` is `2`), have a deposit witness status of `1` or `3`, have an `account_type` that matches the withdrawal currency or is `ALL`, and differ from the current receiving card. Before calling, call `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/addresscheck` with the new card; when `address_needed` is `true`, save the payee address with `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/address` first.

On success, query the details again. If the details contain a card change suggested by the review (`to_be_changed_card`), use `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/change/process` instead.

app_id.description: Withdrawal request id from `id` of the withdrawal details

card_id.description: New receiving bank card id from `list[].id` of “Get Withdrawal Bank Cards”

The receiving bank card lacks a required payee address. Call `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/addresscheck` for the required fields, add the address through `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/address`, then resubmit

post.description:
Accepts the receiving card change suggested by the review. Used for the “Confirm & update” action on the withdrawal details page. When the withdrawal details return `to_be_changed_card`, the review suggests that the Client switch to that card to continue the withdrawal; after the Client confirms, call this endpoint and the request’s receiving card becomes `to_be_changed_card`.

Before calling, call `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/addresscheck` with `to_be_changed_card.card_id`; when `address_needed` is `true`, save the payee address with `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/address` first. On success, query the details again. When the Client picks a new card themselves, use `PUT /v1/portfolio/withdraw/member/change/card` instead.

post.summary: Check Payee Address of Bank Card
post.description:
Checks whether withdrawing the given currency to the given bank card requires a payee address, and returns the address fields to fill, the card’s current address, and a prefill address for one-tap filling. This endpoint only reads data.

When to call: when `need_payee_address` in the pre-check is `true`, before changing the receiving card of a withdrawal, before confirming a suggested receiving card, and after a withdrawal submission or card change returns business code `2031199`. When `address_needed` is `true`, render the address form from `want_fields` and save it with `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/address`. When `address_valid` is `false`, the address must be completed or corrected before the withdrawal can continue.

post.summary: Update Payee Address of Bank Card
post.description:
Saves the payee address of the given bank card. Used to add the address in the withdrawal page, the receiving card change flow, and the suggested card change flow. The change takes effect immediately without review; submitting the same address as the saved one changes nothing.

Call `POST /v1/portfolio/withdraw/card/addresscheck` first to get `want_fields`. All 7 fields of `address` must be present; pass an empty string for fields not in `want_fields`. After saving, call `POST /v5/portfolio/withdraw` to submit the withdrawal, or continue with the card change endpoint. On failure, show `message` to the Client and retry after correcting the input.

get.description:
Queries the bid and offer rates of each currency against the base currency for the current Broker channel. Used to convert multi-currency amounts into one currency for display in the Broker App, such as converting amounts on deposit and withdrawal pages and summing cash and holdings in the selected currency on the asset overview.

Rates are returned under `universal_exchanges.<account_channel>.spec_exchanges.<group>.exchanges`. Asset conversion reads the `am` group, and reads the `key` group when `am` is missing.

To convert an amount in currency A into currency B, take the two rate items whose `other_currency` is A and B:

- Positive amount: amount × `bid_rate` of A ÷ `offer_rate` of B
- Negative amount: amount × `offer_rate` of A ÷ `bid_rate` of B

No conversion is needed when A and B are the same. When no rate exists for B, display the original amount.

WhaleCore converts fees, limits, and coupon face-value currencies in order previews internally, and you don't need to (and cannot) fetch rates from WhaleCore. Call this operation only when the Broker App displays converted amounts itself.

parameters.name: account_channel
parameters.description: Broker channel

200.description: The request succeeded. The response body contains the result of the “Get Exchange Rates” operation.

universal_exchanges.description: Exchange rates grouped by Broker channel, keyed by `account_channel`

spec_exchanges.description: Rate tables grouped by purpose, keyed by group name. Asset conversion uses the `am` group, or the `key` group when `am` is missing

exchanges.description: Rates of each currency against the base currency

Queries the account holder name forms available to the current Client, such as the English name and the Chinese name. The Broker App shows them in a picker on forms that require the Client's own account name, so the Client doesn't type a name that differs from the account-opening records.

Used to fill in the Client's account name for stock transfers in and out. Also used to prefill and validate the cardholder name when binding a bank card.
